items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] When did you meet this, Juanita? Was her name Anita or Juanita? [INTERVIEWEE] Juanita.

ctx.x: And when he wrote my sister, he told my sister to contact me, because it's something he wanted to say to me, and she never did. Mm-hmm. She said her husband was so sick in the hospital, they had removed a lung, you know, one of his lungs. And she said she just didn't have time to write. But she was so evasive about a lot of things, and when I came down here, it's because she was taking money from at Gonzales, the woman, that she just didn't want to. She felt like I didn't need it, that's why.
When did you meet this, Juanita? Was her name Anita or Juanita?
